data.promptProse: Yuki kneels on the student-council room's long table to outline a cultural-festival poster, her uniform cuffs held back with hair ties. She pauses over a completed section with a poised smile, small movements revealing her excitement. The medium view holds drawing tools and poster edges near her knees, with cabinets behind. Afternoon light brightens the fresh outlines and white blouse, leaving shallow hand shadows on the paper.
